notes.title: Patch Playtest V0.1.13-6_DesignTest
notes.notes:
Dear Dungeoncrawlers!

Version V0.1.13-7_DesignTest brings many changes that significantly differentiate the game from previous builds.

The goal of this update is to test the new game design.
Exploring the dungeon should feel more like an adventure, where challenges can be solved in different ways.

The first level after the tutorial is handcrafted (not procedurally generated) to better showcase the new gameplay approach.

Main changes compared to the demo
[list]
[*] Some enemies can no longer be defeated easily with just the sword.
[*] Enemies have a field of vision and can be ambushed.
[*] Potions now have versatile effects and can also be thrown.
[*] Spells now come with limited charges and can be used up.
[/list]

Minor version changes
[list]
[*] Potion effect icons
[/list]

Would you like to join our Discord, share your thoughts, give feedback and help improve the game?

Then join here: [url=https://discord.gg/MVYvMAbTkY]https://discord.gg/MVYvMAbTkY[/url] Play the Demo and share your thoughts, Your feedback shall help make the game even better!

notes.title: Patch Playtest V0.1.9
notes.notes:

The open playtest will end soon.  If you would like to continue being a playtester, I would be very happy if you come to the Discord server, where I distribute the accesses to the playtest. All others are welcome to continue playing the demo. Many thanks for your feedback so far!

Version 0.1.9 brings some bug fixes, balancing and improvements.

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Rebind keys should now work as intended. If not, try press "Reset All" button. If there are still problems, let me know!
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] New enemy type instead of the lantern mage
[*] Increased attack cooldown on some enemies
[*] Increased dash speed
[*] Adjusted item costs
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Added healing option in stores
[*] Changed Controller default keybindings
[*] Added join Discord button
